name: Battle of Mokra
features: Mokra I, Mokra II and Mokra III settlement strips
notes: Terrain, structures, crossing rules, deployment zones and objective coordinates are authored by js/scenarios/mokra.js. A three-minute Polish deployment countdown completes before the German vanguard enters from the westernmost five-tile strip at 3:00 total elapsed time; later echelons enter at 3:55, 5:05 and 6:25, and the five-combat-minute hold ends at 8:00. This metadata file documents the runtime map contract; no baked French-map texture is applied.
